description: 土壤及地下水污染管制區公告資料 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 環境部環境管理署. 土壤及地下水污染場址公告資料(土壤污染或地下水污染來源明確，其土壤或地下水污染物濃度達土壤或地下水污染管制標準者，所在地主管機關應公告為土壤、地下水污染控制場址)(土壤污染管制區(IsSoil)、地下水污染管制區(IsGw)欄位1表示列管，0表示未列管). Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 環境部環境管理署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
